purpose: Enter a standalone local time through the native browser time input without attaching a date or time zone.
behaviorProvider: Native input type=time through Aegis TextInput.

component: Use a native time input. Values are offset-free HH:mm or HH:mm:ss strings; empty remains an empty string. Add no Date object, midnight fallback or timezone conversion.
Pass min/max and step directly to the input; step defaults to 60 seconds. The browser owns segment editing, localized presentation, picker availability and native validity.
Preserve TextInput controlled/defaultValue behavior, both change callbacks, forwarded input ref, name/form and Field labeling/descriptions. Disabled and readOnly retain native behavior.
host: Supply valid native time values, meaningful constraints and an appropriate seconds step. Own scheduling rules, server validation and any interpretation with a date or time zone.

requirements.statement: Use a native time input. Values are offset-free HH:mm or HH:mm:ss strings; empty remains an empty string. Add no Date object, midnight fallback or timezone conversion.
Pass min/max and step directly to the input; step defaults to 60 seconds. The browser owns segment editing, localized presentation, picker availability and native validity.
Preserve TextInput controlled/defaultValue behavior, both change callbacks, forwarded input ref, name/form and Field labeling/descriptions. Disabled and readOnly retain native behavior.
Supply valid native time values, meaningful constraints and an appropriate seconds step. Own scheduling rules, server validation and any interpretation with a date or time zone.
Supply a visible label, enclosing Field label or accessible name. Use useful host validation and recovery instructions instead of relying on placeholder text.

Owned styling consumes input group tokens. Actual nested shared components retain their own token groups. Preserve keyboard-visible focus and equivalent size metrics across the four theme/mode mappings.

limitations: This source-backed requirement record does not certify a current test result or release approval.
Native picker appearance and available controls vary by browser and platform.
No custom clock dial, timezone conversion, duration arithmetic, range selection or scheduling validation.
